name: math-tactical-classroom-v60-factorization-relentless-boss
description: Offline Math Tactical classroom Windows installer with 90-second factorization questions, a 45-minute mission, PIN-protected teacher access to all five rooms, fast 1–2 hit normal enemies, and a much harder three-phase Archive Warden that engages immediately with 3/5/7 predictive dash chains, phase-scaled speed and steering, projectile pressure, fatigue counter-windows, permanent floor weapons, and encrypted local student results.

scripts.prepare: node scripts/prepare-classroom-v60.js && node scripts/patch-v60-factorization-workshop.js && node scripts/unpack-v61-boss-patch.js && node scripts/patch-v60-boss-v61.js && node scripts/patch-v60-teacher-mode-v604-runner.js scripts/patch-v60-teacher-mode-v604.js && node scripts/patch-v60-relentless-boss-v605.js && npm run prepare:icons
scripts.test: npm run prepare && node --check school-game/v60/main.js && node --check school-game/v60/preload.js && node --check school-game/v60/game.js && node scripts/math-factorization-v605-relentless-static-test.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dir:win: npm run prepare && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never

build.productName: Math Tactical Classroom V60.5 Relentless Boss Edition

nsis.shortcutName: Math Tactical Classroom V60.5 Relentless Boss Edition
